title: Shaman King - Legacy of the Spirits - Sprinting Wolf

match.zip: Shaman King - Legacy of the Spirits - Sprinting Wolf.zip

sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Yoh, Ren, Horohoro and friends; HP, spirits
Yoh and friends; party of spirits with their own HP; Shaman Level and Shaman ID on the status screen
Spirits can be powered up or changed in type (menu options in the game)

Spirits collected in this version differ from Soaring Hawk
Spirits found in this version include e.g. Thug Spirit, Cavalry Statue, Yellow Dragon, Son Goku, Cortez the Matador, Pai-Long Dragon, Yamatano Orochi, Great Oni and many more
Parting with a spirit is permanent; the game asks before letting one go
A party can't be made of mobile spirits only

Spirit choice changes the attack element
If every spirit in your party is at 0 HP you can't continue the fight: heal between battles
Late bosses include the Joto fighters and the Grand Tao King / Grand Tao Dragon

rows: Funbari Shopping Town, Town History Museum, Amidamaru's Grave, Saionji Cemetery, Flame Inn, Sunshine Building
Chokohama Graveyard, Mata Cemetery, Tao Castle, Great Wall of Chori, Calvary Labyrinth, Shikoutei's Tomb, Underground Temple

widgets.text:
Items and spirit cards
Items bought in shops ("How many will you buy?"); money from fights

Spirit collection; trade with Soaring Hawk
Spirit collection; the Soaring Hawk version has a different spirit list

Story chapters
Story through the locations above to the Underground Temple
